analysis_role: post hoc APACHE IVa time-valid sensitivity feasibility audit
apache_rule: complete-case APACHE IVa score included in the adherence denominator model
interpretation: The late-decision APACHE-adjusted subset failed the prespecified balance and effective-sample-size gates. No effect estimate or confidence interval from this exploratory model is used in the manuscript. APACHE IVa is retained as an outcome-blind post-weight severity-balance diagnostic in the full corrected eICU transport analysis.
